description.zh-CN: 最低档位，加入 Axolotl Boosters QQ 群，并在官方交流群获得赞助者头衔。
description.en-US: The entry tier includes the Axolotl Boosters QQ group and a sponsor title in the community group.

description.zh-CN: 帮助团队承担开发工具与模型额度；当前没有额外档位权益。
description.en-US: Helps cover development tools and model usage. There are no additional tier benefits today.

description.zh-CN: 按你的意愿支持项目；所有支持都会用于持续维护和发布。
description.en-US: Support the project on your terms. Every contribution goes toward ongoing maintenance and releases.

description.zh-CN: 教程、视频、整合包或服务器内容合作，欢迎通过 QQ 群或 GitHub Issues 联系。
description.en-US: Tutorials, videos, modpacks, or server content. Reach us through the QQ group or GitHub Issues.

description.zh-CN: 镜像、下载分发、认证服务或工具集成，请在 GitHub Issues 说明合作范围。
description.en-US: Mirrors, distribution, authentication, or tooling integrations. Describe the scope in GitHub Issues.
